section.flight_conditions: Flight conditions: freestream Mach number, atmosphere and gas properties.
section.design: Inlet design: number of ramps, capture height and how the ramp angles are chosen.
section.results: Inlet performance at the design point, or at the slider Mach on the Off-design tab.
section.stations: Flow state in every region of the inlet, from the freestream to the duct.
section.selection: Values of the region or shock selected on the canvas.
section.at_slider_mach: Off-design values at the slider Mach, each with its change from the design point.
label.units: Unit system for dimensional values: SI or Imperial.
label.preset: Load a predefined flight condition and design (for example the X-15 at Mach 6.7).
label.atmosphere: Source of freestream pressure and temperature: standard atmosphere or manual values.
label.altitude: Geometric altitude for the U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976, in km or ft.
label.p_inf: Freestream static pressure p∞, in kPa or psi.
label.t_inf: Freestream static temperature T∞, in K or °R.
label.gamma: Ratio of specific heats γ = cp/cv, dimensionless (1.4 for air).
label.freestream: Freestream state computed from the flight conditions.
label.ramps: Number of compression ramps (0 = pitot inlet with a single normal shock).
label.capture_height: Capture height h_c: cowl-lip height above the ramp leading edge, in m or ft.
label.method: How ramp angles are chosen: the Oswatitsch optimum or your own angles in degrees.
label.geometry: Resulting ramp geometry: per-ramp angles and the throat and cowl dimensions.
label.cowl_lip_wedge: Outer-surface wedge angle of the cowl lip, in degrees (0° = zero-thickness idealisation).
label.off_design_mach: Flight Mach number at which the frozen design is evaluated, dimensionless.
label.chart_capture: Mass capture ratio A0/Ac against freestream Mach number, dimensionless.
label.chart_recovery: Total-pressure recovery p0/p0∞ against freestream Mach number, dimensionless.
label.chart_margin: Cowl margin θmax − required turn at the lip against freestream Mach number, in degrees.
field.mach: Freestream Mach number M∞, dimensionless; drag the slider or type a value.
field.altitude: Geometric altitude for the U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976, in km or ft.
field.p_inf: Freestream static pressure p∞, in kPa or psi.
field.t_inf: Freestream static temperature T∞, in K or °R.
field.gamma: Ratio of specific heats γ = cp/cv, dimensionless (1.4 for air).
field.capture_height: Capture height h_c: cowl-lip height above the ramp leading edge, in m or ft.
field.custom_angle: Incremental deflection of this ramp in degrees, checked against shock detachment.
field.max_cowl: Upper limit on the cowl angle (total turning) of the Oswatitsch optimum, in degrees.
field.wedge: Outer-surface wedge angle of the cowl lip in degrees, added to the turn the cowl imposes (0° = zero-thickness idealisation).
field.off_design_mach: Flight Mach number at which the frozen design is evaluated, dimensionless.
flight.units_toggle: Switch every dimensional value between SI and Imperial units.
flight.mode: Choose the standard atmosphere (altitude) or enter p∞ and T∞ by hand.
flight.error: Why the flight conditions are invalid.
design.ramps: Number of compression ramps, from 0 (pitot) to 4.
design.method: Oswatitsch equal-strength optimum or custom ramp angles.
design.max_cowl: Limit the cowl angle of the Oswatitsch optimum, for example to keep the cowl shock attached (costs recovery).
design.custom_error: Why the custom ramp angles are not valid.
design.advanced: Optional design limits, the cowl lip wedge and the diffuser recovery estimate.
readout.p: Freestream static pressure p∞, in kPa or psi.
readout.T: Freestream static temperature T∞, in K or °R.
readout.rho: Freestream density ρ∞ = p∞/(R T∞), in kg/m³ or slug/ft³.
readout.V: Flight speed V∞ = M∞ a∞, in m/s or ft/s.
readout.p0: Freestream total (stagnation) pressure p0∞, in kPa or psi.
readout.T0: Freestream total (stagnation) temperature T0∞, in K or °R.
readout.Re: Unit Reynolds number ρ∞V∞/μ∞ with Sutherland viscosity, per m or per ft.
readout.throat: Throat height: distance from the cowl lip to the terminal-shock foot, in m or ft.
readout.cowl: Cowl (duct) direction measured from the freestream axis, in degrees.
readout.margin: Cowl margin θmax(M∞) − (cowl angle + lip wedge) in degrees; below 0 the external cowl shock detaches.
ramp_table.ramp: Ramp number, counted from the leading edge.
ramp_table.theta: Incremental flow deflection θ of this ramp, in degrees.
ramp_table.beta: Shock angle β relative to the flow ahead of the shock, in degrees.
ramp_table.m_after: Mach number behind this ramp's shock, dimensionless.
ramp_table.row: Per-ramp values: deflection θ (°), shock angle β (°) and Mach number behind the shock.
kpi.recovery_total: Total-pressure recovery p0/p0∞ after the terminal normal shock, including all oblique shocks, dimensionless.
kpi.M_duct: Mach number behind the terminal normal shock, entering the subsonic duct (behind the last ramp shock if there is no terminal shock), dimensionless.
kpi.mass_capture: Captured over ideal mass flow A0/Ac, dimensionless.
kpi.mass_flow: Captured mass flow ρ∞ V∞ h_c (A0/Ac) per unit span, in kg/s/m or lb/s/ft.
stations.table: Every flow region of the inlet; click a row to select the region on the canvas.
stations.copy: Copy the station table to the clipboard as tab-separated values.
stations.name: Region: ∞ = freestream, k = behind ramp shock k, duct = entering the subsonic duct.
stations.M: Mach number in the region, dimensionless.
stations.p_ratio: Static pressure relative to the freestream, p/p∞, dimensionless.
stations.T_ratio: Static temperature relative to the freestream, T/T∞, dimensionless.
stations.p0_ratio: Total pressure relative to the freestream, p0/p0∞, dimensionless.
stations.theta_deg: Flow direction φ measured from the freestream axis, in degrees.
selection.title: Name of the selected region or shock.
selection.hint: Click a region, shock or the cowl on the canvas to see its values here.
row.M: Mach number in the region, dimensionless.
row.p_ratio: Static pressure relative to the freestream, p/p∞, dimensionless.
row.T_ratio: Static temperature relative to the freestream, T/T∞, dimensionless.
row.p0_ratio: Total pressure relative to the freestream, p0/p0∞, dimensionless.
row.flow_angle: Flow direction measured from the freestream axis, in degrees.
row.p: Static pressure in the region, in kPa or psi.
row.T: Static temperature in the region, in K or °R.
row.beta: Shock angle β relative to the flow ahead of the shock, in degrees.
row.theta: Flow deflection θ across the shock, in degrees.
row.M1: Mach number ahead of the shock, dimensionless.
row.Mn1: Shock-normal Mach number ahead of the shock, M₁ sin β, dimensionless.
row.p2_p1: Static pressure ratio across the shock, dimensionless.
row.p0_loss: Fraction of total pressure lost across the shock, in percent.
row.cowl_angle: Cowl (duct) direction measured from the freestream axis, in degrees.
row.lip_wedge: Outer-surface wedge angle of the cowl lip, in degrees.
notice.group.design: Warnings at the design Mach number.
notice.group.off: Warnings at the off-design Mach number on the slider.
notice.title.error: Results outside the model's validity: read before using the numbers.
notice.title.warn: Results near a model limit or with effects the model does not include.
notice.title.info: Notes about how your inputs were used.
notice.row: Click to show or hide the full text; sources are in the Verification tab.
offdesign.chip: The design frozen for this tab: its Mach number and number of ramps.
offdesign.badge: Inlet regime at the slider Mach: spillage, on-lip, shock-in-duct or detached.
offcard.capture: Mass capture A0/Ac at the slider Mach, dimensionless.
offcard.recovery: Total-pressure recovery p0/p0∞ at the slider Mach, dimensionless.
offcard.M_duct: Mach number entering the subsonic duct at the slider Mach, dimensionless.
offcard.margin: Local cowl margin at the lip at the slider Mach, in degrees (— when the lip flow is subsonic).
offcard.regime: Inlet regime at the slider Mach.
offcard.delta: Change from the design-point value, in the same units.
chart.legend.capture: Line: model mass capture; circles: the validation CFD, when available.
chart.legend.recovery: Solid lines: total and oblique-only recovery; circles: the validation CFD (oblique), when available.
chart.legend.margin: Line: cowl margin at the lip with the current wedge, in degrees; dashed: detachment (0°).
chart.legend.bands: Shaded regime bands along the freestream Mach number.
chart.legend.notes: Notes on what the charts do not model.
chart.cfd_note: Why the validation CFD points are not shown for this design.
chart.axis.margin: Cowl margin at the lip, in degrees.
status.compute: Time to compute the design and the off-design sweep, in ms.
status.model: Gas model and ratio of specific heats γ used for every result.
canvas.overlay: Computation status or the reason the inlet cannot be drawn.
drawer.title: Item explained: its governing relations, this case's numbers and a plain-language note.
drawer.topics: Topics: the freestream, each shock and region, the cowl lip, the design method, off-design and separation.
toolbar.toggle_left: Show or hide the inputs panel (Ctrl+[).
toolbar.toggle_right: Show or hide the results panel (Ctrl+]).
toolbar.fit: Fit the drawing to the canvas (F or double-click).
toolbar.layer: Show or hide this layer on both canvases.
toolbar.explain: Open the Explain drawer: equations, this case's numbers and a plain-language note for the selected item.
flight.advanced: Gas properties: the ratio of specific heats γ.
overlay.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts of the main window; they are off while a text field has focus.
tour.card: Short tour of the main window; Skip ends it and it does not show again.
section.welcome_new: Start a new design from the validation case or from the default inputs.
section.welcome_recent: Designs you opened or saved recently, with design Mach, ramps and date.
section.welcome_examples: Flight presets and example designs shipped with Busemann; examples open as untitled copies.
welcome.preset: Start a new untitled design with this flight condition.
welcome.open: Open a design: a Busemann DXF, or any DXF with ramp and cowl lines.
welcome.recent: Click a recent design to open it.
welcome.example: Start from a flight preset, or open an example design as an untitled copy.
welcome.tour: Show a three-step tour of the main window after this window closes.
welcome.hint: Esc opens the main window with the default design.
welcome.title: Busemann, a design lab for external-compression supersonic inlets.
welcome.thumbnail: A 3D render of a generic two-ramp inlet (the validation geometry extruded to a finite width), with streamlines turning at each shock.
welcome.recent_empty: Designs you save or open appear here.
design.capture_mode: What drives the capture size: the capture height, or the engine's required mass flow and the inlet width.
label.capture_mode: What drives the capture size: the capture height, or the engine's required mass flow and the inlet width.
label.mdot: Required engine mass flow at the design point, in kg/s or lb/s (read-only when the capture height drives the design).
field.mdot: Required engine mass flow at the design point, in kg/s or lb/s (read-only when the capture height drives the design).
label.inlet_width: Inlet width (span) of the 2D inlet, in m or ft; optional unless sizing to a mass flow.
field.inlet_width: Inlet width (span) of the 2D inlet, in m or ft; optional unless sizing to a mass flow.
label.diffuser: Estimated total-pressure recovery of the subsonic diffuser behind the terminal shock, dimensionless (not computed by Busemann).
field.diffuser: Estimated total-pressure recovery of the subsonic diffuser behind the terminal shock, dimensionless (not computed by Busemann).
kpi.engine_face: Engine-face recovery estimate: the inviscid recovery times the subsonic diffuser recovery you entered (an estimate, not computed).
kpi.mil: Engine-face estimate (inviscid recovery × diffuser) against the MIL-E-5008B recovery at this Mach; the inviscid value is not compared.
kpi.gap: Total-pressure recovery of these custom angles relative to the Oswatitsch equal-strength design with the same Mach and number of ramps.
offcard.supplied: Mass flow the inlet captures at the slider Mach (spillage included) through the inlet width, in kg/s or lb/s.
offcard.demanded: Fixed engine demand you entered for sizing, in kg/s or lb/s (engine matching not modelled: taken as constant with Mach).
offcard.chip: Surplus or shortfall of the supplied mass flow against the engine demand at the slider Mach.
ramp_table.sensitivity: Change of total-pressure recovery per degree of this ramp's angle (central differences, custom angles only).
playback.play: Play or pause a sweep of the off-design Mach number from 1.2 to the design Mach plus 1.5 (Space while the canvas or tab is focused).
playback.speed: Sweep speed: 1× moves the Mach number by 0.5 per second.
section.verification: Every approximation and warning of the current design, with the criterion used and its source.
verification.summary: Number of verification items; the tab badge counts the warnings and errors.
verification.title: What is approximate or flagged, and how severe it is.
verification.criterion: The criterion or check used, with the current values.
verification.text: What the item means for the design; every item must be verified with a CFD solver.
verification.quote: Validation evidence from the project's own CFD that applies to this design.
right.tabs: Results of the current design, or the Verification list of approximations and warnings.
design.method_optimum: Oswatitsch optimum: equal-strength shocks, maximum total-pressure recovery for this number of ramps.
tab.design: The inlet at its design point: shocks, flow regions and geometry.
tab.offdesign: How this fixed inlet performs at other flight Mach numbers.
tab.analytics: Recovery trade studies for the current design: ramps, turning and design Mach.
analytics.view: Recovery against total turning at this design Mach, or against the design Mach.
analytics.turning: Best total-pressure recovery at each total turning (cowl angle) for 1 to 4 ramps, with the isentropic limit dashed and this design as the ring; hover a point for its numbers, click it to pick it.
analytics.mach: Best total-pressure recovery (Oswatitsch optimum, no cowl limit) for 0 to 4 ramps at each design Mach, with this design as the ring; hover a point for its numbers, click it to pick it.
analytics.cowl: Cowl angle (total turning) of each optimum, with θmax(M∞) above which the cowl lip shock detaches.
analytics.mil: MIL-E-5008B specifies the engine-face recovery, so compare it with recovery × diffuser recovery, not with the inviscid curves.
analytics.takeaway: Computed from the curves above at this design Mach.
analytics.drag_mach: Additive (spillage) drag, cowl pressure drag and their sum against M∞ for this design, as an inviscid estimate: pressure drag only, no skin friction; shaded where the cowl shock is detached.
analytics.drag_recovery: Recovery against cowl pressure drag at the design Mach along each turning curve (inviscid estimate: pressure drag only, no skin friction); hover a point for its numbers, click it to pick it.
analytics.drag: Inviscid estimate: pressure drag only, no skin friction, subcritical spillage, cowl beyond its frontal height or 3D effects.
offcard.cd_add: Additive (spillage) drag coefficient at the slider Mach, on q∞ × capture height (inviscid estimate: pressure drag only, no skin friction).
offcard.cd_cowl: Cowl pressure drag coefficient at the slider Mach, on q∞ × capture height, over the cowl frontal height (inviscid estimate: pressure drag only, no skin friction).
field.cowl_frontal_height: Frontal height of the cowl's outer face as a fraction of the capture height, used only for the cowl pressure-drag estimate (0.01 to 1).
label.cowl_frontal_height: Frontal height of the cowl's outer face, as a fraction of the capture height (drag estimate only).
analytics.char: Recovery against mass-flow ratio at the off-design slider Mach: supercritical branch (quasi-1D), critical point (ring), subcritical branch and buzz onset (approximate); hover a point for its numbers.
analytics.char_separation: Shown because the separation check flags a ramp shock: with separation on the compression surface Ferri & Nucci found a smaller stable range.
field.diffuser_area_ratio: Exit-to-entry area ratio of the subsonic diffuser, used only for the inlet characteristic in Analytics (1 to 4).
label.diffuser_area_ratio: Exit-to-entry area ratio of the subsonic diffuser (inlet characteristic only).
analytics.apply: Set the ramp count, the design Mach and (for a cowl-limited point) the max cowl angle to the picked point, as one undo step.
banner.imported: The geometry came from a DXF without Busemann data, so the flight conditions are the ones in the left panel.
offdesign.charts_toggle: Show or hide the off-design charts: mass capture, recovery and cowl margin against the flight Mach number.
kpi.cowl_margin: Cowl margin θmax − cowl turn at the lip, in degrees; below 0° the external cowl shock is detached.
results.banner: Click to see the warnings below.
results.export: Export the geometry (DXF, Gmsh .geo), the CFD domains (DXF) or the results (CSV, JSON).
drawer.topic: Click to open the explanation of this topic in its own window.
tab.compare: Compare a pinned design (A) with the current design (B): drawings, key numbers and off-design curves.
toolbar.pin: Pin the current design as slot A of the Compare tab (P).
compare.title: Slot A is a frozen pinned or loaded design; slot B is the live design set in the left panel.
compare.swap: Make the pinned design the current one and pin the current one (one undo step).
compare.load_a: Load a DXF design into slot A; a drawing from another program is imported with the current flight conditions.
compare.load_b: Open a DXF design as the current design (the same as File ▸ Open).
compare.overlay: Draw A's walls and shocks as a thin dashed outline over B in one canvas.
compare.conditions: The two designs fly at different Mach number, pressure, temperature or γ, so their numbers are not like for like.
compare.canvas_a: The pinned design A, on the same scale and Mach colours as B.
compare.canvas_b: The current design B, on the same scale and Mach colours as A.
compare.empty: Pin the design on the Design tab (P) or load a DXF into slot A.
compare.table: Inputs and results of A and B; Δ is B − A, green where B is better and amber where it is worse.
compare.copy: Copy the table as tab-separated text.
compare.curves: Off-design capture, recovery and cowl margin of A (dashed) and B (solid), each with its design-Mach line.
iso.section_inputs: Flight conditions and the size of the isentropic compression.
iso.follow: Keep M∞, γ and the capture height equal to the main window's design, and δ equal to its cowl angle.
iso.specify: Choose whether you set the total turning δ or the final Mach number; the other follows from the Prandtl–Meyer function.
iso.delta: Total turning of the compression surface, equal to the cowl angle, in degrees.
iso.mf: Mach number at the end of the compression fan, ahead of the terminal normal shock, dimensionless.
iso.h_c: Capture height: lip height above the leading edge, in metres.
iso.section_results: Results of the isentropic ramp: exact within the simple-wave model.
iso.recovery: Total-pressure recovery: the fan is isentropic, so the only loss is the terminal normal shock at the final Mach number, dimensionless.
iso.engine_face: Engine-face estimate: the recovery times the subsonic diffuser recovery of the main window's design (Design ▸ Advanced), dimensionless.
iso.mil: MIL-E-5008B reference recovery at this M∞, for comparison with the engine-face estimate; a specification line, not a model result.
iso.final_mach: Mach number at the end of the fan, ahead of the terminal normal shock, dimensionless.
iso.h_t: Duct entry height: the last characteristic measured normal to the flow, where the terminal normal shock stands, in millimetres.
iso.cowl_margin: θmax at M∞ minus the cowl turn; below 0° the external cowl shock detaches, in degrees.
iso.wall_length: Length of the curved compression surface from the leading edge to the end of the fan, in millimetres.
iso.multi: Best multi-ramp recovery (Oswatitsch optimum, cowl angle limited to this δ) for 1 to 4 ramps at the same M∞.
iso.export: Write the compression surface as a DXF drawing or a Gmsh geometry, with verification notes beside it.
iso.canvas: Compression fan whose characteristics all meet at the cowl lip, coloured by p/p∞ (constant along each characteristic, see the legend); hover the wall for local values.
